sources.title: World Misophonia Awareness Day brings together organizations from around the globe.  — soQuiet Misophonia Advocacy

quotes.text: World Misophonia Awareness Day will be observed annually on July 9th.

Organizations dedicated to misophonia, a condition marked by intense emotional and physical reactions to certain sounds, have come together internationally to establish July 9th as World Misophonia Awareness Day.

sources.title: Celebrating Belgium’s National Day

quotes.text: Belgian National Day commemorates an event that occurred July 21, 1831. On that day, Leopold of Saxe-Cobourg swore allegiance to the new Belgian Constitution and became the first King of the Belgians.
July 21 is a day of national pride for Belgians, who celebrate this public holiday with concerts, parties, fireworks and other festive events.
